expand_urls_with_weights: expand a colon-separated URL string into a list with optional per-URL weights
expand_urls_without_weights: expand a colon-separated URL string into a flat list of resolved URLs
envsubst_substitute_variables: substitute dollar-brace environment variable references in a string using WDS_ or CHUG_ prefixes
envlookup_resolve_env: resolve an environment variable by name using WDS_ or CHUG_ prefixes
expand_urls_brace_expansion: expand URLs with brace expansion patterns like s3://bucket/file-{1..10}.shard
